coordinates.locator: KM3NeT-Fr research-infrastructure page; corroborated by the Letter of Intent for KM3NeT 2.0 ('located at 42°48' N 06°02' E at a depth of 2450 m, about 40 km offshore from Toulon, France')
coordinates.note: Coordinate given to arc-minute precision by both the official KM3NeT-Fr site page and the 2016 Letter of Intent (design report); precision_m set to 2000 m to reflect that resolution.

depth.note: The general 'ARCA and ORCA detectors' overview page rounds this to 'about 2500 m'; the site-specific page and the Letter of Intent both give 2450 m, which is used here as the more precise, directly-matching figure.

name: KM3NeT-Fr / ORCA site (Toulon)
notes: Distance offshore (~40 km from Toulon) is sourced but not modelled as a field in this schema; recorded in summary.technical.

summary.plain: A patch of Mediterranean seabed about 40 kilometres off Toulon, France, 2450 metres down, where the ORCA neutrino telescope is being built.
summary.technical: KM3NeT-Fr deep-sea installation site, ~40 km offshore Toulon, France, at 42°48'N 06°02'E, 2450 m depth; hosts the KM3NeT/ORCA detector.
